summary: Tested Equipment Shop feature in Step 7 (Equipo) of character creator. Backend /api/data/equipment-catalog endpoint returns all item categories with prices. Frontend shop UI fully functional with 5 categories, search filter, cart functionality, and money balance updates.
critical_code_review_comments: Step7Equipment.jsx properly uses /api/data/equipment-catalog endpoint for base prices
Shop categories correctly mapped: weapons (29), armor (8), tools (35), general (108), consumables (107)
Money conversion functions (convertirAMc, convertirDesdeMc, precioEnMe) work correctly
Cart state management handles adding/removing items properly
data-testid attributes properly implemented for toggle-shop-btn, shop-tab-*, shop-search-input, add-/remove- item buttons
seed_data_creation: None - uses existing equipment_catalog data in MongoDB
context_for_next_testing_agent: Equipment shop in Step7Equipment.jsx fully functional. Character creation flow: ELFOS > ELFOS NOLDOR > complete stats/skills > HEREDERO DE GONDOLIN background > CAPITÁN occupation > complete weapons/armor > reach Equipment step. Shop toggle button has data-testid='toggle-shop-btn'. Initial money for CAPITÁN: 23 mp (20 from Próspero level + 2 mp from occupation money).

equipment_catalog_endpoint.details: /api/data/equipment-catalog returns all categories with prices. 15 pytest tests passed.

shop_categories.details: All 5 categories display items: Armas (29), Armaduras (8), Herramientas (35), Equipo General (108), Consumibles (107)

search_filter.details: Search input filters items correctly. Tested with 'espada' - filtered to show matching weapons.

add_to_cart.details: Items can be added to cart. Toast notification confirms addition. Badge shows item count.

balance_update.details: Money balance updates correctly when purchasing. Tested: 23 mp → 22 mp + 98 mc after buying 2 mc Bastón. Later: 23 mp → 3 mp after buying 2x 10 mp Coleto de cuero.

insufficient_money.details: Items become greyed out (opacity-50) when user cannot afford them. Add button disabled.

money_system_verified.initial_money_captain: 23 mp (Próspero: 20 mp + Capitán occupation: 2 mp + 50 me + 95 mc)
money_system_verified.currency_conversion: 10 me = 1 mc, 10 mc = 1 mp, 100 mp = 1 mo
money_system_verified.balance_after_purchase: Correctly deducted and displayed with remaining change
